quadrature.scope: normalized regional requested moments; two-order agreement is not an error certificate

contract.occupancy: geometric bulk-region measure, not solid fraction or porosity; free complement excludes represented porous bulk
contract.compression: supplied boundary continuity contribution, not a pressure residual
contract.permeation: supplied-state local resistance response; no pressure solve
contract.fibre_flow: transverse 2D cylinder sections; longitudinal response requires axial formulation or 3D
contract.reference: Böttcher et al. (2025), Implicit Incompressible Porous Flow using SPH, arXiv:2504.07739v2
